snippet.title: No Means Nothing | Announcement Trailer (Anti-Dating Sim • Psychological Horror)
snippet.description:
🎮 Wishlist on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/3706160/Bober_Bros_No_Means_Nothing/
PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR // ANTI-DATING SIM about learning to say NO

💬 Join our Discord → https://discord.com/invite/6rR3mXgq73
❤️ Support on Patreon → https://www.patreon.com/SuperBoberBros

About the game
• Relatable workplace dread — pressure, boundaries, consequences.
• Choices matter: yes/no/silence shift the power balance.
• Multiple endings; ~1 hour per run.
• Atmosphere over jumpscares.
• Inspired by real events.

CREDITS:
Sound Design - Rodion Nikitinskikh
